known_secrets.text: For years I have secretly written down every version of important village legends.
Some stories share identical phrases despite originating from different families.
One recurring phrase appears unusually often: 'The Stair must not be completed.'
Nobody currently uses that phrase in daily speech.
The phrase appears in stories from multiple bloodlines.
I suspect all village legends originate from a much older story.
I have hidden copies of my notes in several locations.
I fear someone might destroy them if they knew what I was collecting.

unknowns: Cause of the Night of Ash
